name: supreme-origin-viewer
description: Supreme Origin 아카이브 뷰어 프로토타입 — HAUS NOWHERE SEOUL

scripts.asset:convert: uv run --with numpy --with pillow python -I tools/fbx2glb.py tools "$FBX" build/gm_building_raw.glb
scripts.asset:optimize: npx -y @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 optimize build/gm_building_raw.glb public/assets/gm_building.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 2048 --simplify false --join false --flatten false
scripts.asset: npm run asset:convert && npm run asset:optimize
scripts.nowhere:optimize: mkdir -p public/assets/nowhere/mobile && for L in ground present future; do npx -y @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 optimize build/nowhere/raw/nowhere-$L.glb public/assets/nowhere/nowhere-$L.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --prune-attributes false --join false --flatten false --palette false --simplify false --instance true --instance-min 2 && npx -y @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 optimize build/nowhere/raw/nowhere-$L.glb public/assets/nowhere/mobile/nowhere-$L.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 512 --prune-attributes false --join false --flatten false --palette false --simplify false --instance true --instance-min 2 || exit 1; done && npx -y @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 optimize build/nowhere/raw/nowhere-backdrop.glb public/assets/nowhere/nowhere-backdrop.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 512 --prune-attributes false --join false --flatten false --palette false --simplify false --instance true --instance-min 2 && cp public/assets/nowhere/nowhere-backdrop.glb public/assets/nowhere/mobile/nowhere-backdrop.glb
scripts.nowhere:ds2:optimize: mkdir -p public/assets/nowhere-ds2/mobile && for L in ground present future; do npx -y @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 optimize build/nowhere/raw-ds2/nowhere-$L.glb public/assets/nowhere-ds2/nowhere-$L.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --prune-attributes false --join false --flatten false --palette false --simplify false --instance true --instance-min 2 && npx -y @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 optimize build/nowhere/raw-ds2/nowhere-$L.glb public/assets/nowhere-ds2/mobile/nowhere-$L.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 512 --prune-attributes false --join false --flatten false --palette false --simplify false --instance true --instance-min 2 || exit 1; done && npx -y @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 optimize build/nowhere/raw-ds2/nowhere-backdrop.glb public/assets/nowhere-ds2/nowhere-backdrop.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 512 --prune-attributes false --join false --flatten false --palette false --simplify false --instance true --instance-min 2 && npx -y @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 optimize build/nowhere/raw-ds2/nowhere-backdrop.glb public/assets/nowhere-ds2/mobile/nowhere-backdrop.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 512 --prune-attributes false --join false --flatten false --palette false --simplify true --simplify-ratio 0.5 --simplify-error 0.0002 --simplify-lock-border true --instance true --instance-min 2
